name: app-store-preflight-skills
title_zh: 上架前先扫一遍苹果会拒你的 37 个雷区
tagline_zh: 被拒后改到崩溃？提交前扫一遍工程，揪出隐私清单、订阅文案、权限描述里的坑。不是猜。
tagline_en: Tired of rejection loops? Scan your Xcode project pre-submission for privacy, subscription, and entitlement.
desc_en: Scan an iOS/macOS Xcode project for common App Store rejection patterns before submission. Use when preparing an app for App Store review, after receiving a rejection from Apple, or when auditing metadata, subscriptions, privacy manifests, entitlements, or design compliance. Integrates with the asc CLI for metadata inspection.
why_zh: 别人靠经验猜，它靠规则查。把苹果审核指南里散落的拒绝条款变成可执行的检查项。
why_en: Others guess from experience; it checks against rules. Turns scattered rejection clauses into executable checks, even validating.
limit_zh: 只认 Xcode 工程和 asc CLI 能读到的元数据；UI 截图、App 内购买项目实物。
limit_en: Only checks metadata readable from Xcode projects and asc CLI; UI screenshots, live IAP products, and review notes are out of scope. Results are.
title_en: Preflight scan for 37 common App Store rejection traps
